comment: SAFE-BY-DEFAULT EXAMPLE (interfaces.md §6.5 / WP5). This file is committed to the repository, so it must never contain a usable token. Default listener is loopback (127.0.0.1) with an empty auth_token, which is only reachable from the local machine. If you change host to a non-loopback address (e.g. 0.0.0.0) for TaishanPi LAN access, you MUST set auth_token to a strong shared token (>= 16 chars, e.g. `python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))"`); the Companion refuses to start otherwise, and placeholder values such as REPLACE_WITH_... are rejected.
